rationale: Black Sea drone attack sinks ship near Romanian waters; German spy arrest threatens regional intelligence cooperation; Ukraine escalates with massive Moscow drone strike.

top_events.title: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
top_events.label: Ship sinks Black Sea drone attack crew missing
top_events.summary: Vessel sinks in Black Sea following drone attack as Russia intensifies strikes. Direct threat to Romanian maritime security and Black Sea shipping routes critical to regional economy.

top_events.title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
top_events.label: German spy chief arrested for treason espionage
top_events.summary: August Hanning arrested for obtaining classified information for foreign power. Threatens NATO and EU intelligence sharing affecting Romania's security cooperation with Western allies.

top_events.title: Ukraine launches major drone attack on Russia's Moscow region, killing two
top_events.label: Ukraine drones strike Moscow region kill two
top_events.summary: 290 drones targeted Moscow in overnight assault. Major escalation in conflict affecting Black Sea region security and potential Russian response near Romanian borders.
